name: List a game's seasons
description: Every season of the game, newest first. The index of past seasons, whose standings GET /v1/games/{game}/leaderboard?season=<slug> reads and which are kept for ever.

input.query: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM games WHERE slug = ($1)::text) AS found, coalesce((SELECT json_agg(season_json(s) ORDER BY s.number DESC) FROM seasons s JOIN games g ON g.id = s.game_id WHERE g.slug = ($1)::text), '[]'::json) AS body

with.name: No such game
with.description: One answer for an unknown game on every public read: 404, as the podium, the series and the maps answer, rather than a 200 with an empty body that an unknown game and a game with nothing in it would share.
